relationships.subject: Resolvin D1
relationships.evidence_quote: RvD1 significantly reduced mechanical and thermal allodynia in SNI mice in a dose-dependent manner.

relationships.subject: Resolvin D1
relationships.evidence_quote: RvD1 treatment significantly downregulated TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6 expression (P < 0.001).

relationships.subject: Resolvin D1
relationships.evidence_quote: Expression of BDNF in microglia was significantly increased after SNI whereas RvD1 treatment reversed the upregulation of BDNF expression in the spinal cord (Fig. 3B).

relationships.subject: Resolvin D1
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, the effects of RvD1 on SNI mice and LPS-induced BV2 microglial cells were abrogated by the ALX/FPR2 inhibitor Boc2.

key_findings: Intrathecal RvD1 dose-dependently relieved SNI allodynia and lowered spinal TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6 and microglial BDNF via ALX/FPR2.
TrkB antagonist K252a reversed RvD1's anti-inflammatory effects, implicating BDNF/TrkB signaling.
